references.text: God announces that he will let it rain for 40 days and 40 nights – directly fulfilled in 7:17 where the flood lasts 40 days.
The rain was upon the earth for 40 days and 40 nights, which parallels the duration of the flood described in 7:17.
The continuation describing how the waters rose greatly and the ark floated on the surface of the water, an elaboration of 7:17.
The Lord reigned over the floodwaters – referring to God's sovereign control over the floodwaters, linked to Noah's flood.
By faith Noah built the ark to save his household – the entire flood event including the rising waters that carried the ark.
In Noah's days eight souls were saved through water – a direct reference to the flood and the ark being lifted up by the water.
God did not spare the ancient world but preserved Noah when he brought the flood upon the ungodly – a direct reference to the great flood.
A direct continuation of the same event showing the total duration and scope of the floods.
Theological symmetry showing God's control over the duration of judgment and the beginning of salvation.
